verdict.rationale: Mangopay documents custom fraud-detection rules (docs-7) and a Profiler that flags bots, VPN use and other suspicious session behavior (docs-32). Its webhooks could feed event notifications into alerting (docs-14), and mandatory hosted KYC/KYB covers user onboarding compliance (docs-34). These are payment- and user-level fraud tools, not a portfolio risk view of sellers. Missing for 10: per-sub-merchant fraud and credit-risk scoring or dashboard, anomalous-seller alerts, documented payout pause/hold controls, seller offboarding tools, and any independent corroboration.
